rules.title: Offer returned items to the next person waiting
criteria: Choose the first eligible person on the waitlist
Hold the returned item for 24 hours while they decide
Offer it to the next person if they decline or the offer expires
assumptions: Returned items are held for the next person waiting for 24 hours

rules.title: Let members choose pickup reminders
criteria: Save each member’s reminder preference
Send the reminder before the agreed pickup time
Cancel reminders when the pickup is cancelled

rules.title: Download my lending history
criteria: Export only the signed-in member’s own loans
Include item names, dates, and loan outcomes
Exclude private pickup addresses and contact details
assumptions: Members can export only their own loan records

rules.title: Make returned items available immediately
criteria: Require the owner to confirm the return
Show the returned item as available to everyone
Allow a new borrowing request immediately
assumptions: Returned items become available to everyone immediately

rules.title: Make listing photos faster to browse
criteria: Validate the photo format and size
Create a small preview for listing cards
Keep the original photo and its orientation
assumptions: Only the listing owner can change its photos

rules.title: Find nearby items by category
criteria: Filter items by category and neighborhood
Keep keyword search available
Show a helpful empty state when no items match
assumptions: Public listings show the neighborhood, not an exact address

rules.title: Protect member pickup details
criteria: Show exact pickup details only after confirmation
Allow only the owner and confirmed borrower to view them
Keep public listings limited to the neighborhood
assumptions: Private contact details are never part of a public listing

rules.title: Help neighbors agree on a pickup time
criteria: Let the owner propose pickup times
Let the borrower confirm a time
Notify both people when the time changes
assumptions: A pickup can be arranged only for a reserved item

rules.title: Reserve an item for one borrower
criteria: Check that the item is available
Reserve it for only one neighbor at a time
Explain when an item is on loan or held for someone waiting
assumptions: An item has at most one active reservation or loan

conflicts.firstPattern: held for the next person waiting
conflicts.explanation: One task holds a returned item for the next person waiting. The other makes it available to everyone immediately. Agree on who gets first choice before changing the return rules.
